memories.text:
- Asthma
  - Status: New diagnosis, symptoms 2-3 times/week, nocturnal cough twice/month, ACT score 18.
  - Plan: Start salbutamol MDI SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS; educate on inhaler technique; schedule spirometry.
- Weight & waist
  - Status: Weight 55 kg, waist 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm).
  - Plan: Maintain balanced diet, regular activity.
- Due: Next HbA1c due: Not applicable (no diabetes).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 100 mcg SOS
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler 1-0-1 (after food)
Montelukast 10 mg tablet HS (after food)

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: FEV1 2.1 L (68% predicted), FVC 2.8 L (85% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.75. Post‑bronchodilator FEV1 2.5 L (80% predicted), improvement 19% (>12% and 200 mL) – positive reversibility.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been using my reliever inhaler almost daily and wake up coughing at night about twice a week. I’m worried about my breathing during work trips.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

  - Plan: Keep current diet, add brisk walk 30 min daily.
- Due: Next HbA1c due: Not applicable (no diabetes).
